definitions.explanation: The act of printing text or characters onto a surface, typically using a printer, stamp, or typewriter.

examples.japanese: ⟦レシート→レシート：05291_reshiito⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{印字|いんじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧。
examples.english: The print on the receipt is faint.

examples.japanese: ⟦ラベル→ラベル：00348_raberu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{商品名|しょうひんめい}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{印字|いんじ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: To print the product name on a label.

examples.japanese: {感熱紙|かんねつし}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦レシート→レシート：05291_reshiito⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{時間|じかん}が{経|た}つ→時間が経つ：24138_jikangatatsu⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧{印字|いんじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{消|き}えて→消える：02520_kieru⟧しまうこと⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: The print on thermal paper receipts can fade over time.

notes:
Composed of {印|いん} (print, stamp) + ⟦{字|じ}→字：01606_ji⟧ (character, letter). Refers specifically to the printing of text characters, as opposed to images or graphics. Commonly used in business and manufacturing contexts for labels, receipts, and documents.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {印字|いんじ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to print (characters)
- {印字|いんじ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{薄|うす}い→薄い：00764_usui⟧ — the print is faint
- {印字|いんじ}⟦{品質|ひんしつ}→品質：09507_hinshitsu⟧ — print quality
- {印字|いんじ}⟦{速度|そくど}→速度：03319_sokudo⟧ — print speed
- {印字|いんじ}⟦{面|めん}→面：09933_men⟧ — printed surface

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{印刷|いんさつ}→印刷：01844_insatsu⟧ — printing; broader term covering all types of printing, including images and mass production
- ⟦プリント→プリント：01539_purinto⟧ — print; loanword used for printing in general
- ⟦{刻印|こくいん}→刻印：29469_kokuin⟧ — engraving, stamping; physically pressing characters into a surface
